subject: general
question: What is the compound interest on Rs. 8400 for 2 years at 10% per annum compounded annually?
solution:
**Given:- **

Principal amount(P) = 8400 

Time = 2 year 

Rate % = 10%

**Formula used:- **

Compound Interest = P ( 1 + R/100 )T - P

where T = time and P = principal R = Rate of interest 

**Calculation:- **

Compound Interest = 8400 ( 1 + 10/100)² - 8400 

⇒ 8400 (110/100)² - 8400 

⇒ 10164 - 8400 = 1764** 

 ∴ The required answer is__ 1764__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

R% = 1/10 

P = 10

A = 10 + 1 =11 

⇒ Principle → Amount 

 

⇒ 10 → 11

For 2 years

⇒ (10)² → (11)² 

⇒ 100 → 121 

So, CI = 121 - 100 = 21

Comparing the real data 

 ⇒ CI = (21/100) × 8400 =1764
